subject: MAP Runbook + Rollout Calendar — owners & milestone confirmations
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Marquez <elena@lumenfin.com>, Samuel Johnson <samuel.johnson@lumenfin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Runbook + Rollout Calendar — owners & milestone confirmations

Elena / Sam —

Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) runbook and a rough rollout calendar for the LumenFin integration. I pulled together milestones from our discovery call and a proposed owner for each item so we can accelerate the kickoff next week.

High level ask: please review owners, dates, and any missing gating items (security, compliance, procurement), and flag anything that should shift before we lock calendar invites.

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Runbook_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 98 KB)

Summary (top-level):
- Kickoff: proposed Tue Aug 3, 2026 — 60 min technical + business stakeholders
- Pilot environment ready (dev/test): target Aug 17, 2026 — Redwood infra + LumenFin test data setup
- First validation run (10k tokens/day): Aug 24, 2026 — validation scripts + evaluation prompts
- Production readiness (SLA, fallback policies): Sep 7, 2026 — legal signoff + capacity reservation

Proposed owners (we can reassign):
- Kickoff coordination: Rishi (AE) / Monica (CS)
- Environment provisioning: Aditya (Infra Eng) / LumenFin infra (Sam)
- Security & compliance checklist: Monica + LumenFin Sec Ops (Elena)
- Integration tests & evals: Tessa (Solutions)
- SOW & commercial finalization: Rishi + LumenFin Procurement

Quick notes: I added a gating milestone "Compliance Evidence Review" ahead of Prod Readiness — Monica, can you confirm the expected artifacts?

Next steps:
1) Elena / Sam — confirm kickoff availability and any added milestones (esp compliance/legal).
2) Internal owners — confirm you can meet the proposed dates. If not, send alternatives.
3) I will circulate calendar invites and a living MAP doc (Drive link in next email) once owners are confirmed.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Runbook_v1.xlsx]

From: Elena Marquez <elena@lumenfin.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Johnson <samuel.johnson@lumenfin.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Runbook + Rollout Calendar — owners & milestone confirmations

Thanks, Rishi — this is helpful.

Quick responses:
- Aug 3 kickoff works for our core team (Elena, Sam, and 1 product manager). Please make it 9:00am PT if possible.
- We need a compliance review milestone before Pilot environment completion. Specifically:
  - Evidence: network segmentation diagram, data flow doc, retention policy statement, SOC2 scoping note.
  - Proposed timing: 1 week before Pilot ready (so target Aug 10 for evidence submission).
- Procurement: our procurement lead will need the SOW + an approximate monthly cost run rate. Can you include a pricing stub in the SOW?

I'll loop our Security Ops on a separate thread if needed, but Sam can act as the internal technical point.

Elena
VP, Product — LumenFin

Elena — thanks for the callout on compliance. I updated the milestone list below and added owners/dates that reflect our internal lead times. Please treat these as proposed and we can adjust in the kickoff.

Revised MAP milestones (proposed final):
- 2026-08-03 — Kickoff (60m). Owners: Rishi / Monica. Deliverable: roll-call, objectives, success metrics.
- 2026-08-10 — Compliance Evidence Submission (LumenFin). Owners: Elena (LumenFin) / Monica (Redwood). Deliverable: data flow + retention + segmentation docs.
- 2026-08-17 — Dev/Test Environment Provisioned. Owners: Aditya (Redwood Infra) / Sam (LumenFin Infra). Deliverable: test endpoints, service accounts, example dataset (anonymized).
- 2026-08-24 — Integration Smoke Tests & Eval. Owners: Tessa (Solutions) / Sam. Deliverable: pass/fail report, 10k token test run, prompt evaluation notes.
- 2026-08-31 — Pilot Retrospective & Go/No-Go Recommendation. Owners: Monica / Elena. Deliverable: findings, risk log, next steps.
- 2026-09-07 — Production Readiness & Commercial Finalization. Owners: Rishi / LumenFin Procurement. Deliverable: signed SOW, capacity reservation, runbook published.

Open items / asks:
1) Elena — can you confirm who will own the compliance evidence bundle (a single email with all artifacts) by Aug 10? If it's a different contact, cc them on the kickoff invite.
2) Aditya — we will need the dev/test creds and a small quota allocation announced by Aug 12; is that doable?
3) Rishi — please prepare a pricing stub for the SOW; I attached our standard SOW template to speed legal review.

Attachment: SOW-template.docx (docx, 42 KB)

I will prepare the calendar invites once we lock kickoff time (Rishi: please send the invite for Aug 3 at 9:00am PT if that works).

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Elena / Sam / team —

Thanks for the quick confirmations and Monica for the detailed schedule. Finalizing next steps below — please consider this the official MAP baseline unless someone replies with changes by EOD Thu Jul 29.

Agreed MAP baseline (confirmed):
- Kickoff: 2026-08-03, 09:00 PT — calendar invite sent (Google Calendar). Owner: Rishi / Monica.
- Compliance Evidence: due 2026-08-10 — owner: LumenFin (Elena). Monica will review artifacts and mark pass/conditional.
- Dev/Test Provisioned: 2026-08-17 — owner: Aditya / Sam. Redwood to provide test credentials and interface docs.
- Integration Smoke Tests: 2026-08-24 — owner: Tessa / Sam. Runbook and test scripts attached in Drive after kickoff.
- Pilot Retrospective: 2026-08-31 — owner: Monica / Elena.
- Production Readiness & SOW Sign: 2026-09-07 — owner: Rishi / LumenFin Procurement.

Immediate action items (this week):
1) Rishi — send SOW pricing stub to LumenFin (I will include the template Monica attached). Planned send: Wed Jul 29.
2) Elena — confirm compliance owner or cc on kickoff if it's different (by EOD Thu Jul 29).
3) Aditya — confirm infra provisioning timeline and any required inputs (by Mon Jul 27). If there are blockers, please flag them now.
4) Tessa & Monica — I will share our evaluation prompt set and a short checklist for the smoke tests after kickoff.

References: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9001), DocuSign envelope (https://docusign.com/envelope/EX-12345).

If no objections, I'll lock the calendar and upload the runbook to a shared Drive (link below) and follow up with a single-source-of-truth MAP doc.

Drive MAP (will be shared after kickoff): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDWOOD-LUMEN-MAP

Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
